titulo: Ghosting is a text you didn't write
caption:
Ghosting is a text you didn’t write.
Four kind, clear texts to copy. Shorter than the silence, and kinder.
Link in bio.
by NMR
#dating #ghosting #communication

alt.1: Cella looking at a big phone that is waiting for a text. Save · 4 texts to end it kindly. Ghosting is a text you didn't write. 4 short, kind, clear ones. Copy and send.
alt.2: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. After two dates. I had a nice time, but I'm not feeling a spark. Wishing you well. When you're just not feeling it. Why it works: one clear sentence beats three weeks of silence.
alt.3: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. It keeps fizzling. I like talking to you, but I don't see this going anywhere. Leave it here? When you still talk, but it goes nowhere. Why it works: it says it out loud and asks.
alt.4: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. They want more. You deserve someone who's all in. I'm not. I'm sorry. When they're serious and you're not. Why it works: honesty now saves them months.
alt.5: a chat bubble with the text, and a small Cella in the corner. From the other side. Hey, are we still talking? A yes or no is fine. When they go quiet on you. Why it works: you ask for the answer, not the reason.
alt.6: the four texts as a list. The cheat sheet. Ending it, said clearly: Send it to someone who ghosted you. Cella has ghosted since 2019. Very consistent. 1. Nice time. No spark. 2. Leave it here? 3. I'm not all in. Sorry. 4. A yes or no is fine.
